Travelers and pet owners, please review the latest guidance before check-in so your companion can travel safely and calmly.

The Companion Animal Travel Desk of Aurelia Skyways is here to help with planning, documents, and handover details from booking through arrival. We treat each journey as a shared responsibility, and we encourage you to prepare early, keep records ready, and speak with us if anything changes. <<FACT F071>> Clear preparation helps protect your pet and keeps the process smooth for everyone.
